com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:read consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; no repricing, stock reservation or publication.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: An account without an approved store receives a tool error. No matches return an empty page; malformed continuation cursors return a tool error.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Aggregate stock counts, customer purchases and changing listings are outside this read.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: List individual listings owned by the connected seller's store, newest first.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns listing rows with status, condition, price, quantity and product URL, plus pagination and generation time.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use to inspect listing-level prices, quantities or status; nextCursor continues with the same status filter and limit.
